title: Narasimha Sahasranamam
intro: Narasimha Sahasranamam is the sacred hymn of the 1000 names of Lord Narasimha. Devotees chant it for protection, courage, and freedom from fear and negativity.
description:
Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Sahasranama Stotram

|| Poorvapithika ||

Markandeya uvacha |
Evam yuddhamabhudghoram raudram daityabalaih saha |
Nrisimhasyangasambhutaistarasirhairanekasah || 1 ||

Daityakotirhatastatra kechidbhietah palayitah |
Tam drishtvaativa sankruddho hiranyakasipuh svayam || 2 ||

Bhootapoorvairamrityurme iti brahmavaroddhatah |
Vavarsha sharvarshena narasimho bhrisham bali || 3 ||

Dvandvayuddhamabhudugram divyavarshasahasrakam |
Daityendre sahasam drishtva devashchendrapurogamah || 4 ||

Shreyah kasya bhavedatra iti cintapara bhavan |
Tada kruddho nrisimhastu daityendraprohitanyapi || 5 ||

Vishnuchakram mahachakram kalachakram tu vaishnavam |
Raudram pashupatam brahma kaumberam kulishasanam || 6 ||

Aagneyam varunam saumyam mohanam souraparvatatam |
Bhargavadi bahunyastranyabhakshyata kopanah || 7 ||

Sandhyakale sabhadvare svanke nikshipta bhairavah |
Tatah khadgadharam daityam jagraha narakesari || 8 ||

Hiranyakasiporvaksho vidaryaativa roshitah |
 Uddhritya chantramalani nakhairvajrasamaprabhaih || 9 ||

Mene kritarthamatmanam sarvatah paryavaikshata |
Harshita devatah sarvah pushpavrishtimavakiran || 10 ||

Devadundubhayo nedurvimalashca dishobhavan |
Narasimhamatiwogram vikirnavadanam bhrisham || 11 ||

Lelihanam ca garjantam kalanalasamaprabham |
Atiraudram mahakayam mahadamshtram maharutam || 12 ||

Mahasimham maharoopam drishtva sankshubhitam jagat |
Sarvadevaganaih sartham tatragatya pitamahah || 13 ||

Aagantukairbhootapoorvairvartamanairanuttamaih |
Gunairnamasahasrena tushtava shrutisammataih || 14 ||

Om namah srimaddivyalakshminrisimha sahasranamastotramahamantrasya brahma rishih, shrilakshminrisimho devata, anushtupchandah, shrinrisimhah paramatma bijam, lakshmirmaya shaktih, jivo bijam, buddhih shaktih, udanavayuh bijam, saraswati shaktih, vyanjanani bijani, swarah shaktayah, om kshroum hrim iti bijani, om shrim am am iti shaktayah, vikirnanakhadamshtrayudhayeti kilakam, akaraditi bodhakam, shrilakshminrisimha prasadsiddyarthe shrilakshminrisimha sahasranamastotra mantrajape viniyogah |

Nyasah –
Om shrilakshminrisimhaya namah – angushthabhyam namah |
Om vajranakhaya namah – tarjanibhyam namah |
Om maharudraya namah – madhyamabhyam namah |
Om sarvatomukhaya namah – anamikabhyam namah |
Om vikatasyaya namah – kanishthikabhyam namah |
Om viraya namah – karatalakaraprishtabhyam namah |
Evam hridayadinyasah |

Digbandhah –
Om aindrim disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om aagneyim disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om yamyam disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om nairritim disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om varunim disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om vayavim disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om kaumberim disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om ishanim disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om urdhvam disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om adhastaddisam disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |
Om antariksham disam sudarsanena badhnami namaschakraya svaha |

Atha Dhyanam.
Satyajnanasukhaswaroopamamalam kshirabdhimadhye sthitam
Yogarudhamatiprasannavadanam bhushasahasrojwalam |
Tryaksham chakrapinakasabhayakaran bibhranamarkachchavim
Chhatribhootaphaniendramindudhavalam lakshminrisimham bhaje || 1 ||

Upasmahe nrisimhakhyam brahma vedantagocharam |
Bhooyolalitasamsarachchhedahetum jagadgurum || 2 ||

Atha Stotram.
Brahmovacha |
Om hrim srim aim kshroum ||
Om namo narasimhaya vajradamshtraya vajrine |
Vajradehaya vajraya namo vajranakhaya cha || 1 ||

Vasudevaya vandyaya varadaya varatmane |
Varadabhayahastaya varaya vararupine || 2 ||

Varenyaya varishthaya shrivaraya namo namah |
Prahladavaradayai cha pratyakshavaradaya cha || 3 ||

Paratparapareshaya pavitraya pinakine |
pavanaya prasannaya pashine papaharine || 4 ||

Purushtutaya punyaya puruhutaya te namah |
Tatpurushaya tathyaya puranapurushaya cha || 5 ||

Purodhase purvajaya pushkarakshaya te namah |
Pushpahasaya hasaya mahahasaya sharangine || 6 ||

Simhaya simharajaya jagadvashyaya te namah |
Attahasaya roshaya jalavasaya te namah || 7 ||

Bhootavasaya bhasaya shrinivasaya khadgine |
Khadgajihvaya simhaya khadgavasaya te namah || 8 ||

Namo muladhivasaya dharmavasaya dhanvine |
Dhananjayaya dhanyaya namo mrityunjayaya cha || 9 ||

Shubhanjayaya sutraya namah shatrunjayaya cha |
Niranjanaya niraya nirgunaya gunaya cha || 10 ||

Nishprapanchaya nirvanapradaya nibidaya cha |
Niralambaya nilaya nishkalaya kalaya cha || 11 ||

Nimeshaya nibandhaya nimesagamanaya cha |
Nirdvandvaya nirashaya nischayaya niraya cha || 12 ||

Nirmalaya nibandhaya nirmohaya nirakrite |
Namo nityaya satyaya satkarmanirataya cha || 13 ||

Satyadhvajaya munjaya munjakeshaya keshine |
Harishaya cha sheshaya gudakeshaya vai namah || 14 ||

Sukeshayordhvakeshaya keshisamharakaya cha |
Jaleshaya sthaleshaya padmeshayograrupine || 15 ||

Kushesayaya kulaya keshavaya namo namah |
Sooktikarnaya sooktaya raktajihvaya ragine || 16 ||

Diptarupaya diptaya pradiptaya pralobhine |
Prachinnaya prabodhaya prabhave vibhave namah || 17 ||

Prabhanjanaya panthaya pramayapramitaya cha |
Prakashaya pratapaya prajvalayojjvalaya cha || 18 ||

Jvalamalaswarupaya jvalajjihvaya jvaline |
Mahojjvalaya kalaya kalamurtidharaya cha || 19 ||

Kalantakaya kalpaya kalanaya krite namah |
Kalachakraya shakraya vashatchakraya chakrine || 20 ||

Akruraya kritantaya vikramaya kramaya cha |
Krittine krittivasaya kritaghnaya kritatmane || 21 ||

Sankramaya cha kruddhaya krantalokatrayaya cha |
Arupay swarupaya haraye paramatmane || 22 ||

Ajayayadidevaya akshayaya kshayaya cha |
Aghoraya sughoraya ghoraghorataraya cha || 23 ||

Namostvaghoraviryaaya lasadghoraya te namah |
Ghoradhyakshaya dakshaya dakshinaaryaya shambhave || 24 ||

Amoghaya gunoughaya anaghayaghaharine |
Meghanadaya nadaya tubhyam meghatmane namah || 25 ||

Meghavahanarupaya meghashyamaya maline |
Vyalyajnopavitaya vyaghradehaya vai namah || 26 ||

Vyaghrapadaya cha vyaghrakarmine vyapakaya cha |
Vikatasyaya viraya vishTarashravase namah || 27 ||

Vikirnanakhadamshtraya nakhadamshtrayudhaya cha |
Vishvaksenaya senaya vihvalaya balaya cha || 28 ||

Virupakshaya viraya visheshakshaya sakshine |
Vitashokaya vistirnavadanaya namo namah || 29 ||

Vidhanaya vidheyaya vijayaya jayaya cha |
Vibudhaya vibhavaya namo vishambharaya cha || 30 ||

Vitaragaya vipray vitankanayanaya cha |
Vipulaya vinitaya vishvayone namo namah || 31 ||

Vidambanaya vittaya vishrutaya viyonaye |
Vihvalaya vivadaya namo vyahritaye namah || 32 ||

Vilasaya vikalpaya mahakalpaya te namah |
Bahukalpaya kalpaya kalpatitataya shilpine || 33 ||

Kalpanaya swarupaya phanitalpaya vai namah |
Taditprabhaya tarkshyaya tarunaya tarasvine || 34 ||

Tapanaya tarakshaya tapatrayaharaya cha |
Tarakaya tamoghnaya tattvaya cha tapasvine || 35 ||

Takshakaya tanutraya tatine taralaya cha |
Shatarupaya shantaya shatadharaya te namah || 36 ||

Shatapatrayatakshaya sthitaye shatamurtaye |
Shatakratuswarupaya shashvataya shatatmane || 37 ||

Namah sahasrashirase sahasravadanaya cha |
Sahasrakshaya devaya dishashrotraya te namah || 38 ||

Namah sahasrajihvaya mahajihvaya te namah |
Sahasranamadheyaya sahasrakshidharaya cha || 39 ||

Sahasrabahave tubhyam sahasracharanaya cha |
Sahasrarkaprakashaya sahasrayudhadharine || 40 ||

Namah sthulaya sukshmay susukshmay namo namah |
Sukshunnaya subhikshaya suradhyakshaya shaurine || 41 ||

Dharmadhyakshaya dharmaya lokadhyakshaya vai namah |
Prajadhyakshaya shikshaya vipakshakshayamurtaye || 42 ||

Kaladhyakshaya tikshnaya muladhyakshaya te namah |
Adhokshajaya mitraya sumitravarunaya cha || 43 ||

Shatrughnaya avighnaya vighnakotiharaya cha |
Rakshoghnaya tamoghnaya bhootaghnaya namo namah || 44 ||

Bhootpalaya bhootaya bhootavasaya bhutine |
Bhootavetalaghataya bhootadhipataye namah || 45 ||

Bhootagrahavinashaya bhootasamyamate namah |
Mahabhootaya bhrigave sarvabhootatmane namah || 46 ||

Sarvarishtavinashaya sarvasampatkaraya cha |
Sarvadharaya sharvaya sarvartiharaye namah || 47 ||

Sarvaduhkhaprashantaya sarvasaubhagyadayine |
Sarvajnayapyanantaya sarvashaktidharaya cha || 48 ||

Sarvaishvaryapradatre cha sarvakaryadhayine |
Sarvajvaravinashaya sarvarogapaharine || 49 ||

Sarvabhicharahantre cha sarvaishvaryadhayine |
Pingakshayaikasringaya dvisringaya marichaye || 50 ||

Bahusringaya lingaya mahasringaya te namah |
Mangalyaya manojnaya mantavyaya mahatmane || 51 ||

Mahadevaya devaya matulingadharaya cha |
Mahamayaprasutaya prastutaya cha mayine || 52 ||

Anantanantarupaya mayine jalashayine |
Mahodaraya mandaya madadaya madaya cha || 53 ||

Madhukaitabhahantre cha madhavaya muraraye |
Mahaviryaaya dhairyaya chitraviryaaya te namah || 54 ||

Chitrakurmaya chitraya namaste chitrabhanave |
Mayatitataya mayaya mahaviraya te namah || 55 ||

Mahatejaya bijaya tejodhamne cha bijine |
Tejomayanrisimhaya namaste chitrabhanave || 56 ||

Mahadamshtraya tushtaya namah pushtikaraya cha |
Shipivishtaya hrishtaya pushtaya parameshthine || 57 ||

Vishishtaya cha shishtaya garishthayeshtadayine |
Namo jyeshthaya shreshthaya tushtayamitatejase || 58 ||

Ashtanganyastarupaya sarvadushtantakaya cha |
Vaikunthaya vikunthaya keshikanthaya te namah || 59 ||

Kanthiravay lunthaya nishshathaya hathaya cha |
Sattvodriktaya rudraya rigyajussamagaya cha || 60 ||

Rritudhvajaya vajraya mantrajaya mantrine |
Trinetraya trivargaya tridhamne cha trishuline || 61 ||

Trikalajnanarupaya tridehaya tridhatmane |
Namastrimurtividyaya tritattvajnanine namah || 62 ||

Akshobhyayaniruddhaya aprameyaya bhanave |
Amritaya anantaya amitayamitaujase || 63 ||

Apamrityuvinashaya apasmaravighatine |
Annadayannarupaya annayannabhuje namah || 64 ||

Nadyaya niravadyaya vidyayadbhutakarmane |
Sadyojataya sanghaya vaidyutaya namo namah || 65 ||

Adhvatitataya sattvaya vagatataya vagmine |
Vagishvaraya gopaya gohitaya gavan pate || 66 ||

Gandharvaya gabhiraya garjitayorjitaya cha |
Parjanyaya prabuddhaya pradhanapurushaya cha || 67 ||

Padmabhaya sunabhaya padmanabhaya manine |
Padmanetraya padmaya padmayah pataye namah || 68 ||

Padmodaraya putaya padmakalpodhbhavaya cha |
Namo hritpadmavasaya bhupadmoddharanaya cha || 69 ||

Shabdabrahmaswarupaya brahmarupadharaya cha |
Brahmane brahmarupaya padmanetraya te namah || 70 ||

Brahmadaya brahmanaya brahmabrahmatmane namah |
Subrahmanyaya devaya brahmanyaya trivedine || 71 ||

Parabrahmaswarupaya panchanbrahmatmane namah |
Namaste brahmashirase tathaashwashirase namah || 72 ||

Atharvashirase nityamashanipramitaya cha |
Namaste tikshnadamshtraya lolaya lalitaya cha || 73 ||

Lavanyaya lavitraya namaste bhasakaya cha |
Lakshanajnaya lakshaya lakshanaya namo namah || 74 ||

Lasaddiptaya liptaya vishnave prabhavishnave |
Vrishnimalaya krishnaya srimahavishnave namah || 75 ||

Pashyami tvam mahasimham harinam vanmalinam |
Kiritinam kundalinam sarvangam sarvatomukham || 76 ||

Sarvatah panipadorah sarvatoakshishiromukham |
Sarveshvaram sadatushtam samartham samarpriyam || 77 ||

Bahuyojanavistirnam bahuyojanamayatam |
Bahuyojanahastanghrim bahuyojananasikam || 78 ||

Maharoopam mahavaktram mahadamshtram mahabhujam |
Mahanadam maharaudram mahakayam mahabalam || 79 ||

Aanabherbrahmano roopamagaladvaishnavam tatha |
Aashirshadrudrameeshanam tadagre sarvatah shivam || 80 ||

Namostu narayananarasimha
Namostu narayanavirasimha |
Namostu narayanakrurasimha
Namostu narayanadivyasimha || 81 ||

Namostu narayanavyaghrasimha
Namostu narayanapuchchhasimha |
Namostu narayanapoornasimha
Namostu narayanaraudrasimha || 82 ||

Namo namo bhishanabhadrasimha
Namo namo vihvalanetrasimha |
Namo namo brimhitabhootasimha
Namo namo nirmalachitrasimha || 83 ||

Namo namo nirjitakalasimha
Namo namah kalpitakalpasimha |
Namo namo kamadakamasimha
Namo namaste bhuvanaekasimha || 84 ||

Dyavaprithivyoridamantaram hi
Vyaptam tvayaikena dishashcha sarvah |
Drishtvadbhutam rupamugram tavedam
Lokatrayam pravyathitam mahatman || 85 ||

Ami hitva surasangha vishanti
Kechidbhietah pranjalayo grinanti |
Svastiityuktva munayah siddhasanghah
Stuvanti tvam stutibhih pushkalabhih || 86 ||

Rudradityavasavo ye cha sadhya
Vishvedeva marutashchoshmpashcha |
Gandharvayakshasurasiddhasangha
Viekshanti tvam vismitashchaiva sarve || 87 ||

Lelihyase grasamanah samanta-
-llokan samagranvadanajvaladbhih |
Tejobhirapurya jagatsamagram
Bhasastavograh pratapanti vishno || 88 ||

Bhavishnustvam sahishnustvam bhrjishnurjishnureva cha |
Prithivimantariksham tvam parvataranyameva cha || 89 ||

Kalakashthaviliptastvam muhurtapraharadikam |
Ahoratram trisandhya cha pakshamasartuvatsarah || 90 ||

Yugadiryugabhedastvam sanyugo yugasandhayah |
Nityam naimittikam dainam mahapralayameva cha || 91 ||

Karanam karanam karta bharta harta tvamishvarah |
Satkarta satkritirgopta sachchidanandavigrahah || 92 ||

Pranastvam praninam pratyagatma tvam sarvadehinam |
Sujyotistvam paranjyotiratmajyotih sanatanah || 93 ||

Jyotirlokaswarupastvam gno jyotirjyotisham patih |
Svahakarah svadhakaro vashatkarah kripakarah || 94 ||

Hantakaro nirakaro vegakarashcha shankarah |
 Akaradihakaranta omkaro lokakarakah || 95 ||

Ekaatma tvamanekaatma chaturatma chaturbhujah |
Chaturmurtishchaturdamshtrashchaturvedamayottamah || 96 ||

Lokpriyo lokagururlokesho lokanayakah |
Lokasakshi lokapatirlokatma lokalochana || 97 ||

Lokadharo brihalloko lokalokamayo vibhuh |
Lokakarta vishvakarta kritavartah kritagamah || 98 ||

Anadistvamanantastvamabhooto bhootavigrahah |
Stutih stutyah stavpritah stota neta niyamakah || 99 ||

Tvam gatistvam matirmahyam pita mata gurus sakhah |
Suhridashcatmarupastvam tvam vina nasti me gatih || 100 ||

Namaste mantrupayastravarupaya te namah |
Bahurupaya rupaya pancharupadharaya cha || 101 ||

Bhadrarupaya rudhaya yogarupaya yogine |
Samarupaya yogaya yogapithasthitaya cha || 102 ||

Yogagamyaya saumyaya dhyanagamyaya dhyayine |
Dhyeyagamyaya dhamne cha dhamadhipataye namah || 103 ||

Dharadharaya dharmaya dharanabhirataya cha |
Namo dhatre cha sandhatre vidhatre cha dharaya cha || 104 ||

Damodaraya dantaya danavantakaraya cha |
Namah sansaravaidyaya bheshajaya namo namah || 105 ||

Siradhvajaya shitaya vatayapramitaya cha |
Sarasvataya sansaranashanayakshamaline || 106 ||

Asicharmadharayaiva shatkarmanirataya cha |
Vikarmaya sukarmaya parakarmadhayine || 107 ||

Susharmane manmathaya namo varmaya varmine |
Karicharmavasanaya karalavadanaya cha || 108 ||

Kavaye padmagarbhaya bhootagarbha ghrinanidhe |
Brahmagarbhaya garbhaya brihadgarbhaya dhurjate || 109 ||

Namaste vishvagarbhaya shrigarbhaya jitaraye |
Namo hiranyagarbhaya hiranyakavachaya cha || 110 ||

Hiranyavarnadehaya hiranyakshavinashine |
Hiranyakasiporhantre hiranyanayanaya cha || 111 ||

Hiranyaretase tubhyam hiranyavadanaya cha |
Namo hiranyasringaya nihsringaya cha sringine || 112 ||

Bhairavaya sukeshaya bhishanayantramaline |
Chandaya rundamalaya namo dandadharaya cha || 113 ||

Akhandatattvarupaya kamandaludharaya cha |
Namaste khandasinhaya satyasinhaya te namah || 114 ||

Namaste shvetasinhaya pitasinhaya te namah |
Nealsinhaya nilaya raktasinhaya te namah || 115 ||

Namo haridrasinhaya dhumrasinhaya te namah |
Mulasinhaya mulaya brihatsinhaya te namah || 116 ||

Patalasthitasinhaya namah parvatavasine |
Namo jalasasthasinhaya antarikshasthitaya cha || 117 ||

Kalagnirudrasinhaya chandasinhaya te namah |
Anantsinhasinhaya anantagataye namah || 118 ||

Namo vichitrasinhaya bahusinhaswarupine |
Abhayankarasinhaya narsimhaya te namah || 119 ||

Namostu sinharajaya narasimhaya te namah |
Saptabdhimekhalayaiva satyasatyaswarupine || 120 ||

Saptalokantarasthaya saptaswaramayaya cha |
Saptarchirupadamshtraya saptashvaratharupine || 121 ||

Saptavayuswarupaya saptachchhandomayaya cha |
Swachchhaya swachchharupaya swachchhandaya cha te namah || 122 ||

Shrivatsaya suveshaya shrutaye shrutimurtaye |
Shuchishravaya shooraya suprabhaya sudhanvine || 123 ||

Subhraya surnathaya suprabhaya shubhaya cha |
Sudarsanaya sukshmaya niruktaya namo namah || 124 ||

Suprabhaya svabhavaya bhavaya vibhavaya cha |
Sushakhaya vishakhaya sumukhaya mukhaya cha || 125 ||

Sunakhaya sudamshtraya surathaya sudhaya cha |
Sankhyaya suramukhyaya prakhyataya prabhaya cha || 126 ||

Namah khatvangahastaya khetamudgarapanaye |
Khagendraya mrigendraya nagendraya dridhaya cha || 127 ||

Nagakeyuraharaaya nagendrayaghamardine |
Nadivasaya nagnaya nanarupadharaya cha || 128 ||

Nageshvaraya nagaya namitaya naraya cha |
Nagantkarathayaiva naranarayanaya cha || 129 ||

Namo matsyaswarupaya kachchapaya namo namah |
Namo yajnavarahaya narasimhaya te namah || 130 ||

Vikramakrantalokaya vamanaya mahaujase |
Namo bhargavaramaya ravanantakaraya cha || 131 ||

Namaste balaramaya kansapradhvansakarine |
Buddhaya buddharupaya tikshnarupaya kalkine || 132 ||

Atreyayagninetraya kapilaya dvijaya cha |
Kshetraya pashupalaya pashuvaktraya te namah || 133 ||

Grihasthaya vanasthaya yataye brahmacharine |
Svargapavargadatre cha tadbhoktre cha mumukshave || 134 ||

Shalagramanivasaya kshirabdhisayanaya cha |
Shrishailadrinivasaya shilavasaya te namah || 135 ||

Yogihritpadmavasaya mahahasaya te namah |
Guhavasaya guhyaya guptaya gurave namah || 136 ||

Namo muladhivasaya nilavastradharaya cha |
Pitavastraya shastraya raktavastradharaya cha || 137 ||

Raktamalavibhushaya raktagandhanulepine |
Dhurandharaya dhurtaya durdharaya dharaya cha || 138 ||

Durmadaya durantaya durdharaya namo namah |
Durnirikshyaya nishthaya durdarsaya drumaya cha || 139 ||

Durbhedaya durashaya durlabhaya namo namah |
Driptaya driptavaktraya adriptanayanaya cha || 140 ||

Unmattaya pramattaya namo daityaraye namah |
Rasajnaya raseshaya araktarasanaya cha || 141 ||

Pathyaya paritoshaya rathyaya rasikaya cha |
Urdhvakeshordhvarupaya namaste chordhvaretase || 142 ||

Urdhvasinhaya simhaya namaste chordhvabahave |
Parapradhvansakayaiva shankhachakradharaya cha || 143 ||

Gadapadmadharayaiva panchanbanadharaya cha |
Kameshvaraya kamaya kamapalaya kamine || 144 ||

Namah kamviharaya kamarupadharaya cha |
Somasuryagninetraya somapaya namo namah || 145 ||

Namah somaya vamaya vamadevaya te namah |
Samasvanaya saumyaya bhaktigamyaya vai namah || 146 ||

Kooshmandagannathaya sarvashreyaskaraya cha |
Bhishmaya bhishadayai cha bhimavikramanaya cha || 147 ||

Mrigagrivaya jivaya jitayajitakarine |
Jatine jamadagnyaya namaste jatavedase || 148 ||

Japakusumvarnaya japyaya japitaya cha |
Jarayujayandajaya svedajayodbhijaya cha || 149 ||

Janardanaya ramaya jahnavijanakaya cha |
Jarajanmadiduraya pradyumnaya pramodine || 150 ||

Jihvaraudraya rudraya virabhadraya te namah |
Chidrupay samudraya kadrudray prachetase || 151 ||

Indriyayendriyajnaya namostvindranujaya cha |
Atindriyaya saraya indirapataye namah || 152 ||

Ishanaya cha idyaya ishitaya inaya cha |
Vyomatmane cha vyomne cha namaste vyomakeshine || 153 ||

Vyomadharaya cha vyomavaktrayasuraghatine |
Namaste vyomadamshtraya vyomavasaya te namah || 154 ||

Sukumaraaya ramaya shubacharaya vai namah |
Vishvaya vishvarupaya namo vishvatmakaya cha || 155 ||

Jnanatmakaya jnanaya vishveshaya paratmane |
Ekaatmane namastubhyam namaste dvadashatmane || 156 ||

Chaturvimshatirupaya panchanvimshatimurtaye |
Shadvimshakatmane nityam saptavimshatikatmane || 157 ||

Dharmarthakamamokshaya viraktaya namo namah |
Bhavashuddhaya siddhaya sadhyaya sharabhaya cha || 158 ||

Prabodhaya subodhaya namo buddhipriyaya cha |
Snigdhaya cha vidagdhaya mugdhaya munaye namah || 159 ||

Priyamvadaya shravyaya sruksruvaya shritaya cha |
Grieshaya maheshaya brahmeshaya namo namah || 160 ||

Sridharaya sutirthaya hayagrivaya te namah |
Ugraya ugravegaya ugrakarmarataya cha || 161 ||

Ugranetraya vyagraya samagragunashaline |
Balagrahavinashaya pishachagrahaghatine || 162 ||

Dushtagrahanihantre cha nigrahanugrahaya cha |
Vrishadhvajaya vrishnyaya vrishaya vrishabhaya cha || 163 ||

Ugrashravaya shantaya namah shrutidharaya cha |
Namaste devadevesha namaste madhusoodana || 164 ||

Namaste pundarikaksha namaste duritakshaya |
Namaste karunasindho namaste samitinjaya || 165 ||

Namaste narsimhaya namaste garudadhvaja |
Yajnanetra namestu kaladhvaja jayadhvaja || 166 ||

Agninetra namestu namaste hyamarapriya |
Mahanetra namestu namaste bhaktavatsala || 167 ||

Dharmanetra namestu namaste karunakara |
Punyanetra namestu namastebhishtadayaka || 168 ||

Namo namaste jayasinharoopa
Namo namaste narsimharoopa |
Namo namaste ranasinharoopa
Namo namaste narsimharoopa || 169 ||

Uddhritya garvitam daityam nihatyajou suradvisham |
Devakaryam mahatkritva garjase svatmatejasa || 170 ||

Atiraudramidam roopam dussaham duratikramam |
Drishtva tu shankitah sarvah devatastvamupagatah || 171 ||

Etanpashya maheshanam brahmanam mam shachipatim |
Dikpalan dvadashadityan rudranuragarakshasan || 172 ||

Sarvan rshiganan saptamatrgaurim sarasvatim |
Lakshmim nadishcha tirthani ratim bhootagananyapi || 173 ||

Prasida tvam mahasimha ugrabhavamimam tyaja |
Prakritistho bhava tvam hi shantibhavam cha dharaya || 174 ||

Ityuktva dandavadbhumau papata sa pitamahah |
Prasida tvam prasida tvam prasadeti punah punah || 175 ||

Markandeya uvacha |
Drishtva tu devatah sarvah shrutva tam brahmano giram |
Stotrenapi cha samhrishtah saumyabhavamadharayat || 176 ||

Abraviinnarasimhastu veekshya sarvan surottaman |
Santrastan bhayasamvignan sharanam samupagatan || 177 ||

Shrinrisimha uvacha |
Bho bho devavarah sarve pitamahapurogamah |
Shrunudhvam mama vakyam cha bhavantu vigatajvarah || 178 ||

Yaddhitam bhavatam noonam tatkarishyami sampratam |
Evam namasahasram me trisandhyam yah pathet shuchih || 179 ||

Shrinoti va shravayati pujante bhaktisamyutah |
Sarvan kamanavapnoti jivechcha shardam shatam || 180 ||

Yo namabhirnrisimhadhyairarchayetkramasho mama |
Saratirtheshu yatpunyam sarvatirtheshu yatphalam || 181 ||

Sarvapujasu yatproktam tatsarvam labhate bhrisham |
Jatismaratvam labhate brahmajnanam sanatanam || 182 ||

Sarvapapavinirmuktah tadvishnoh paramam padam |
Mannamakavacham badhva vicharedvigatajvarah || 183 ||

Bhootavetalkooshmanda pishachabrahmarakshasah |
Shakinidakinizyeshtha nili balagrahadika || 184 ||

Dushtagrahashcha nashyanti yaksharakshasapannagah |
Ye cha sandhyagrahah sarve chandalgrahasamjnikah || 185 ||

Nishacharagrahah sarve pranashyanti cha duratah |
Kukshirogam cha hridrogam shulapasmarameva cha || 186 ||

Aikahikam dvyahikam cha chaturarthikamatha jvaram |
Adhayo vyadhayah sarve roga rogadhidevatah || 187 ||

Shighram nashyanti te sarve nrisimhasmaranat surah |
Rajano dasatam yanti shatravo yanti mitratam || 188 ||

Jalani sthlatam yanti vahnayo yanti shitatam |
Vishanyapyamrita yanti nrisimhasmaranatsurah || 189 ||

Rajyakamo labhedrajyam dhanakamo labheddhanam |
Vidyakamo labhedvidyam baddho muchyeta bandhanat || 190 ||

Vyalyaghrabhayam nasti chorasarpadikam tatha |
Anukula bhavedbharya lokaishcha pratipujyate || 191 ||

Suputram dhanadhanyam cha bhavanti vigatajvarah |
Etatsarvam samapnoti nrisimhasya prasadatah || 192 ||

Jalasantarane chaiva parvataranyameva cha |
Vaneapi vichiranmartyo durgame vishame pathi || 193 ||

Bilapraveshane chapi narasimham na vismaret |
Brahmaghnashcha pashugnashcha bhroonaha gurutalpagah || 194 ||

Muchyate sarvapapebhyah kritaghnah strivighatakah |
Vedanam dushakashchaapi matapitrivinindakah || 195 ||

Asatyastu tetha yajnanindako lokanindakah |
Smritva sakrinnrisimham tu muchyate sarvakilbishaih || 196 ||

Bahunatra kimuktena smritva mam shuddhmanasah |
Yatra yatra charenmartyo nrisimhastatra rakshati || 197 ||

Gachchan tishthan swapan bhunjan jagrannapi hasannapi |
Nrisimheti nrisimheti nrisimheti sada smaran || 198 ||

Pumanna lipyate papairbhuktim muktim cha vindati |
Nari subhgatameti saubhagyam cha swaroopatam || 199 ||

Bhartuh priyatvam labhate na vaidhavyam cha vindati |
Na sapatnim cha janmante samyak jnani bhavedvijah || 200 ||

Bhumipradakshinanmartyo yatphalam labhate chirat |
Tatphalam labhate narasimhamurtipradakshinat || 201 ||

Markandeya uvacha |
Ityuktva devadevesho lakshmimalingya lilaya |
Prahaldasyaabhishekam tu brahmane chopadishtavan || 202 ||

Shrishailasya prasade tu lokanam cha hitaya vai |
Swaroopam sthapayamasa prakritisthoabhavattada || 203 ||

Brahmapi daityarajanam prahladamabhyashechayat |
Daivataih saha suprito hyatmalokam yayau svayam || 204 ||

Hiranyakasiporbhritya praplayya shachipatih |
Svargarajyaparibhrashto yuganaamekavimsatim || 205 ||

Narsimhena hate daitye svargalokamavapa sah |
Dikpalashcha susampraptah swaswasthanamanutammam || 206 ||

Dharme matih samastanam prajanamabhavattada |
Evam namasahasram me brahmana nirmitam pura || 207 ||

Putranadhyapayamasa sanakadinmahamatih |
Uchuste cha tatah sarvolokanam hitakamyaya || 208 ||

Devatah rishayah siddha yakshavidyadharoragah |
Gandharvashcha manushyashcha ihamutraphalaishinah || 209 ||

Yasya stotrasya pathaddhi vishuddhmanasoabhavan |
Sanatkumarah samprapto bharadvajo mahamatih || 210 ||

Tasmadangirasah praptastasmatprapto mahakratuh |
Jagraha bhargavastasmdagnimitraya soabravit || 211 ||

Jaigishavyaya sa praha soabravichchhyavanaya cha |
Tasma uvacha shandilyo gargaya praha vai munih || 212 ||

Kratunjayaya sa praha jatukarnyaya samyami |
Vishnuvruddhaya sopyahaha sopi bodhayanaya cha || 213 ||

Kramatsa vishvane praha sa prahoddhamakukshaye |
Sinhtejashcha tasmaccha shripriyaya dadau cha nah || 214 ||

Upadishtosmi tenahamidam namasahasrakam |
Tatprasadadamryturme yasmatkasmadbhayam na hi || 215 ||

Maya cha kathitam narasimhstotramidam tava |
Tvam hi nityam shuchirbhutva tamaradhaya shasvatam || 216 ||

Sarvabhootasrayam devam nrisimham bhaktavatsalam |
Poojayitva stavam japtva hutva nischalamanasah || 217 ||

Prapyase mahatim siddhim sarvan kamanvarottaman |
Ayameva paradharmastvidameva param tapah || 218 ||

Idameva param jnanamidameva mahadvratam |
Ayameva sadacharastvayameva sada makhah || 219 ||

Idameva trayo vedah sachchastranyagamani cha |
Nrisimhamantradanyachcha vaidikam tu na vidyate || 220 ||

Yadihasti tadanyatra yannehasti na tatkvachit |
Kathitam te nrisimhasya charitam papanashanam || 221 ||

Sarvamantramayam tapatrayopashamanam param |
Sarvarthasadhanam divyam kim bhuyah srotumichchhasi || 222 ||

Iti shrinrisimhapoorane nrisimhapradurvbhave srimaddivya lakshminrisimha sahasranama stotram ||

faq.a1: Narasimha Sahasranamam is a sacred hymn containing the 1000 divine names of Lord Narasimha, the fourth incarnation of Lord Vishnu. Each name reflects His power, protection, and divine compassion.
faq.q2: What are the benefits of chanting Narasimha Sahasranamam?
faq.a2: Chanting Narasimha Sahasranamam is believed to remove fear, protect devotees from negative influences, increase courage, and bring the blessings of Lord Narasimha.
faq.q3: When should I recite Narasimha Sahasranamam?
faq.a3: It can be recited in the morning or evening. Narasimha Jayanti, Ekadashi, and other Vaishnava festivals are considered especially auspicious.
faq.a4: Yes. Both men and women can chant Narasimha Sahasranamam with faith and devotion.
faq.q5: Can I chant Narasimha Sahasranamam every day?
faq.a5: Yes. Daily recitation is considered auspicious and is believed to bring protection, courage, and spiritual strength.
faq.a6: Narasimha Sahasranamam appears in various Hindu scriptures, including Vaishnava texts and Puranas dedicated to Lord Narasimha.
faq.q7: What is the difference between Narasimha Sahasranamam and Narasimha Kavacham?
faq.a7: Narasimha Sahasranamam contains the 1000 names of Lord Narasimha, while Narasimha Kavacham is a protective hymn recited for divine protection and spiritual security.
faq.a8: Yes. Anyone can chant Narasimha Sahasranamam with sincere devotion. No special initiation is required.
faq.q9: How many times should I recite Narasimha Sahasranamam?
faq.a9: There is no fixed rule. Most devotees recite it once in a sitting, while others chant it according to their devotion.
faq.q10: Which is the best day to chant Narasimha Sahasranamam?
faq.a10: Narasimha Jayanti, Ekadashi, and Vaishnava festivals are considered the most auspicious occasions to chant Narasimha Sahasranamam.
